WHAT ROUND 0021 GOT WRONG, because both errors are the kind that recur. (a) round21_crossover.py checked that the IC arm completed and then charged BOTH arms; instructions() reads callgrind's Collected: line and never sees the worker's JSON, so 4 of 64 rho runs at n37a0 were cut off and charged. An incomplete rho has exhausted its restarts, so it did MORE work than one that found its collision early -- charging it over-charges the denominator and 1.533 was a LOWER bound, not an upper one. (b) Round 0019's 'bigger is monotonically worse' was carried from the eight-cell panel to the new cells. It holds at n23a1 and nowhere beyond: the best base is 8, 16 and 24 orbits at the three cells, and reporting the sampler's default cost the candidate 2.6x at n43a1 -- OVERSTATING its loss, which is the direction a result already going against the candidate will not be challenged on.

OPEN, in rough order of value.

1. The pair-table model's two predictions no longer agree with each other. F = (c*#E*t/k)^(1/3) predicts 30 and 83 orbits at n37a0 and n43a1; measured best bases are 16 and 24, growing about r^0.157 rather than r^(1/3). But r^(1/6) is derived FROM the base sitting at that optimum, and the measured rate is consistent with r^(1/6). So the model gets the rate right at a base measurably not where it puts it, which is a coincidence it does not explain. Deriving the rate for the base that is actually optimal is a theory task, not a measurement, and it is the highest-value open item.

2. A fourth cell needs a rho budget this protocol cannot raise cheaply. Degrees 47, 53, 59 and 61 have certified cells (round22_cell_census.py: n47a1, n53a0, n59a0, n59a1, n61a0, n61a1) and rho completes at none inside max_trials, whose ceiling in the worker is 65,536. max_trials is rho's iterations-per-RESTART, so raising it past that means changing rho's restart policy or the worker -- a real protocol change, not the 14 ppm the 4096 -> 65,536 raise cost.

3. Run `cargo test` on candidate arms. Still open, and round 0022 is the second round in a row whose errors would have been caught earlier by a check the harness does not run: no stage of it verifies that an arm completed, either. A prepare-stage gate that runs the arm's own tests, and a measurement helper that refuses to charge an incomplete run, are both one-time fixes.

4. Nothing on the eight-cell panel. It is untouched by round 0022 -- measured at 4096 trials with a base that is optimal there, both still true -- and further engineering polishes a regime the method is now measured to lose outside, across 1100x in r.
